camera_calibration_toolbox.core.feature_detection.FeatureDetector

class camera_calibration_toolbox.core.feature_detection.FeatureDetector(tag)[source]

Object used for detecting a specified calibration feature in an image.

Which feature the detector tries to detect is determined by the tag upon initialization. Afterwards it can be used to detect the same calibration feature in several images.

__init__(tag)[source]

Class constructor.

Parameters

tag (str) – Tag that describes the feature which needs to be detected.

Raises

  • TagError – When an invalid tag is used. This can occur when the wrong prefix is used, the tag is not long enough or the tail doesn’t contain numeric data.

  • TypeError – When tag is not a string.

detect_feature(image, normalize=False, invert=False)[source]

Attempt to detect the specified feature in the image.

Parameters

  • image (ndarray[Any, dtype[TypeVar(ScalarType, bound= generic, covariant=True)]]) – One- or multi-channel image.

  • normalize (bool) – Whether to normalize the image or not, defaults to False.

  • invert (bool) – Whether to invert the image or not, defaults to False.

Raises

  • ImageError – When image is not 2- or 3-dimensional.

  • TypeError – When the type of image is not a numpy array.
